proposals.prompt:
Agents in a supermarket gridworld must collect their required items and leave through the exit. Every action costs the same, so demonstrators prefer short trajectories -- unless an unknown social norm makes them behave otherwise. Your task is to propose candidate norms (obligations or prohibitions) that could explain the demonstrated behaviour.
Each demonstration is listed step by step as  `k: {atoms true in the state} action`.

Available atoms:
- at(x,y) -- the agent is at cell (x,y); x = column (0 = left), y = row (0 = top); N decreases y, S increases y, E increases x, W decreases x
- hasCart -- the agent is holding/pushing a shopping cart
- actions N, S, E, W, MOVE (any of the four moves), INTERACT (any interaction with an object: the different kinds of interaction are NOT distinguished), EXIT (leave the store; always the last action)

Demonstration 1 (required items: a2):
  0: {at(0,7)} E
  1: {at(1,7)} INTERACT
  2: {at(1,7), hasCart} N
  3: {at(1,6), hasCart} E
  4: {at(2,6), hasCart} E
  5: {at(3,6), hasCart} E
  6: {at(4,6), hasCart} E
  7: {at(5,6), hasCart} N
  8: {at(5,5), hasCart} N
  9: {at(5,4), hasCart} N
 10: {at(5,3), hasCart} E
 11: {at(6,3), hasCart} INTERACT
 12: {at(6,3)} N
 13: {at(6,2)} N
 14: {at(6,1)} INTERACT
 15: {at(6,1)} S
 16: {at(6,2)} S
 17: {at(6,3)} INTERACT
 18: {at(6,3), hasCart} S
 19: {at(6,4), hasCart} E
 20: {at(7,4), hasCart} S
 21: {at(7,5), hasCart} E
 22: {at(8,5), hasCart} S
 23: {at(8,6), hasCart} S
 24: {at(8,7), hasCart} E
 25: {at(9,7), hasCart} E
 26: {at(10,7), hasCart} E
 27: {at(11,7), hasCart} EXIT
 28: {at(11,7), hasCart} <terminal>

Propose norms using ONLY the atoms listed above. Do NOT define any new state properties or events: "abstraction" must be {}.
Propose 8 diverse candidate hypotheses.

Output format: return ONLY a JSON list (no prose, no code fences). Each element:
{"id": short_name, "text": one-sentence natural-language statement of the norm,
 "abstraction": {"state_properties": {name: FORMULA, ...},
                 "events": {name: {"pre": FORMULA, "post": FORMULA or null}, ...}},
 "norm": {"type": "prohibition", "condition": FORMULA}
       | {"type": "obligation", "trigger": FORMULA or "START", "discharge": FORMULA}}
FORMULA := atom | name of a property/event defined in this hypothesis | {"not": F} | {"and": [F, ...]}
         | {"or": [F, ...]} | {"le"|"lt"|"ge"|"gt"|"eq": [numeric_feature, integer]}
Semantics.  A trajectory is a sequence of steps (state s_k, action a_k).  A step's label contains the atoms true in
s_k and the action a_k.  A state property is a formula over state atoms (no actions).  An event
{"pre": P, "post": Q} occurs at step k when P holds for the label of step k and Q holds in the next state s_{k+1}
(post may be null).  A prohibition counts one violation for every step whose label (including events occurring at
that step) satisfies the condition.  An obligation becomes pending at any step satisfying the trigger ("START" =
pending from the beginning) and is fulfilled by a later (or the same) step satisfying the discharge; it can be
triggered again; it is violated if it is still pending when the trajectory ends.

parsed.text: The shopper is obliged to have a cart at some point before completing the trip.
The shopper is prohibited from having a cart in the upper aisle cells at (6,1) or (6,2).
The shopper is prohibited from bringing a cart to cell (6,1).
If the shopper interacts at (6,3) while holding a cart, they are obliged to stop having the cart afterward.
If the shopper interacts at (6,3) without a cart, they are obliged to have the cart afterward.
After interacting at (6,1), the shopper is obliged to have a cart again later.
The shopper is prohibited from exiting the store without a cart.
The shopper is prohibited from moving west in the store.

accepted.description: [g1_no_cart_single_file_shelf_aisles] FORBIDDEN: (hasCart ∧ shopperOnlyAisle)  where shelvesOnBothSides := (shelfE ∧ shelfW); shopperOnlyAisle := (singleFileHorizontalClearance ∧ shelvesOnBothSides); singleFileHorizontalClearance := freeWidthH≤1

[g1_no_cart_entry_to_single_file_aisle] FORBIDDEN: (hasCart ∧ enterShopperOnlyAisle)  where shelvesOnBothSides := (shelfE ∧ shelfW); shopperOnlyAisle := (singleFileHorizontalClearance ∧ shelvesOnBothSides); singleFileHorizontalClearance := freeWidthH≤1; upperAisleMouth := (at(3,3) ∨ at(6,3)); enterShopperOnlyAisle := (N ∧ upperAisleMouth) · shopperOnlyAisle

[g1_park_cart_at_upper_aisle_mouth] OBLIGED: after arriveAtUpperMouthWithCart, eventually cartParkedAtUpperMouth (before exit)  where upperAisleMouth := (at(3,3) ∨ at(6,3)); upperMouthWithCart := (upperAisleMouth ∧ hasCart); arriveAtUpperMouthWithCart := (MOVE ∧ hasCart) · upperMouthWithCart; cartParkedAtUpperMouth := (INTERACT ∧ upperAisleMouth ∧ hasCart) · ¬hasCart

[g1_retrieve_cart_after_single_file_aisle] OBLIGED: after returnFromShopperOnlyAisle, eventually cartRetrievedAtUpperMouth (before exit)  where shelvesOnBothSides := (shelfE ∧ shelfW); shopperOnlyAisle := (singleFileHorizontalClearance ∧ shelvesOnBothSides); singleFileHorizontalClearance := freeWidthH≤1; upperAisleMouth := (at(3,3) ∨ at(6,3)); cartRetrievedAtUpperMouth := (INTERACT ∧ upperAisleMouth ∧ ¬hasCart) · hasCart; returnFromShopperOnlyAisle := (S ∧ shopperOnlyAisle ∧ ¬hasCart) · upperAisleMouth

[g1_cart_drop_only_in_wide_staging_cells] FORBIDDEN: (cartDrop ∧ ¬approvedCartParkingCell)  where approvedCartParkingCell := (wideHorizontalAisle ∧ notBesideShelf); notBesideShelf := ¬adjShelf; wideHorizontalAisle := freeWidthH≥6; cartDrop := (INTERACT ∧ hasCart) · ¬hasCart

[g1_must_take_cart_at_entrance] OBLIGED: after start, eventually takeCartAtEntrance (before exit)  where entranceCartBay := at(1,7); takeCartAtEntrance := (INTERACT ∧ entranceCartBay ∧ ¬hasCart) · hasCart
[g1_exit_only_with_cart] FORBIDDEN: (leaveStore ∧ ¬hasCart)  where exitCell := at(11,7); leaveStore := (EXIT ∧ exitCell)
[g1_one_way_wide_aisles_no_west] FORBIDDEN: westwardTravelInWideAisle  where wideHorizontalCirculationAisle := freeWidthH≥6; westwardTravelInWideAisle := (W ∧ wideHorizontalCirculationAisle)
